entries.retirement_rationale: Literal Go text formatting is intentionally replaced by native compact lists, raw authored details and structured reports. Native command journeys verify stable IDs, semantic JSON fields, stored-byte preservation, errors and real pushed Git history; no behavioral safety check is retired.
Intentional presentation compatibility break: native failures use unsuccessful process exit without preserving Go numeric exit code 3; preserved files/history and conflict abort are covered.

Strengthened ownership: exact generated-temp evidence plus verified untracked state authorizes cleanup; basename-prefix or plan.md.tmp matches alone never authorize deletion of authored/tracked files.
Intentional CLI compatibility break: busy shared flock fails promptly instead of waiting 30 seconds; native test verifies no apply or fetch occurs.
Intentional presentation compatibility break: native failures use unsuccessful process exit without preserving Go numeric exit code 3; preserved files/history and conflict abort are covered.
Intentional strengthened recovery contract: failed Apply retains partial files and op-journal.json instead of destructive reset/clean; native test verifies sync recovers those writes and history.
